articles.summary: The standard transonic benchmark, run against 270 of the 271 published pressure taps. The double-shock structure comes out right and merges where the experiment puts it — and decomposing our own drag killed our first explanation for the part that did not.
articles.title: Getting the λ-Shock Right: ONERA M6 Transonic Validation

articles.summary: Navier AI has been awarded a Phase I SBIR from AFWERX to explore an ontology-based geometry embedding layer that gives AI agents the ability to reason about parts, features, and spatial relationships instead of guessing.
articles.title: Navier AI Awarded AFWERX Phase I SBIR to Build a Geometry Reasoning Layer for Engineering Agents
